capabilities: Toggle between mindmap and Markdown views
Rearrange nodes by drag and drop
extras: Only supports a limited Markdown format; OPML/XMIND import-export and more themes/layouts are listed as future plans, not implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit a Markdown outline as a mindmap.
summary: Mindmap editor that renders Markdown bullet lists as an interactive mindmap you can edit and sync back to the note.
